# Media Partners

> > Media Partners delivers award-winning employee training and development programs focused on compliance, leadership, and workplace culture transformation.

Media Partners specializes in corporate training solutions across compliance, diversity & inclusion, leadership development, and customer service. Their signature storytelling-based methodology and proprietary courses like Once & For All and LEAD NOW! serve diverse industries including healthcare, government, financial services, education, hospitality, and retail.

## Key Topics

- Employee Training & Development
- Compliance Training
- Leadership Development
- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI)
- Sexual Harassment Prevention
- Workplace Violence Prevention
- Manager & Supervisor Training
- Customer Service Excellence
- Workplace Communication
- Unconscious Bias
- Workplace Culture
- Behavior Change
- Soft Skills Development
- Employee Engagement
- Coaching & Facilitation Services

## Core Training Solutions

- [Workplace Training Solutions](https://www.mediapartners.com/training-solutions): Main training solutions page covering compliance, DEI, harassment prevention, and leadership development.
- [Sexual Harassment Training](https://www.mediapartners.com/training-solutions/sexual-harassment): Once & For All sexual harassment training covering legal compliance and behavior change.
- [Diversity And Inclusion Training](https://www.mediapartners.com/training-solutions/diversity-equity-inclusion-belonging): DEI training including unconscious bias and inclusion courses like How Was Your Day?
- [Workplace Violence Prevention](https://www.mediapartners.com/training-solutions/workplaceviolenceprevention): Workplace violence prevention and psychological safety training programs.

## Leadership & Management Development

- [Leadership Development + Leadership Courses](https://www.mediapartners.com/training-solutions/leadershipdevelopment): Leadership development courses including LEAD NOW! for inspired leader growth.
- [Manager Training + Supervisor Training](https://www.mediapartners.com/training-solutions/supervisorandmanagertraining): Manager and supervisor training with Practical Coach 2 and high-performing team building.
- [Coaching & Client Services](https://www.mediapartners.com/training-solutions/client-services): Client coaching and facilitation services using Media Partners Method and culture FACTS.

## Employee Skills & Development

- [Customer Service Training Programs](https://www.mediapartners.com/training-solutions/customerservice): Customer service training with storytelling-based courses like Give 'em the Pickle.
- [Workplace Communication Training](https://www.mediapartners.com/training-solutions/workplacecommunication): Workplace communication skills training covering speaking, listening, and storytelling.
- [Employee Training & Employee Development](https://www.mediapartners.com/training-solutions/employeedevelopment): Employee development courses covering conflict resolution and team building skills.
